GitHub Issues are currently disabled, so a focused pull request is accepted directly. If Issues are enabled later, use this form to prepare the proposal.

## Bot and source path

Name the Bot and the exact file or skill identifier involved.

## Concrete failure or improvement

Provide one input or situation. Explain the expected behavior, actual behavior, and why the difference matters.

## Evidence

Classify each result as prepared, native, offline, or automated. Include the model, date, limitations, and any command used. Do not include secrets, account identifiers, private transcripts, or proprietary material.

## Smallest proposed change

Describe the smallest instruction, profile, check, or fixture change that could resolve the problem. State whether existing identifiers or public Bot links would change.

## Acceptance cases

List the cases that would show the improvement works, including expected results and a clear stop condition.
